title: TaskNote
description: A note of a task: what the agent wants to keep in mind. Notes are only added; a wrong one is corrected by a new one.

number.description: Number of the note within the task, from 1.

text.description: Text of the note; may have several lines.

node.description: Node of the pass the note was added at.

source.description: Who added the note: operator or agent.

added.description: Time the note was added in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.
